description: RPL message parsing test vectors (DIS/DIO/DAO/DAO-ACK per RFC 6550). Round-trip: encode(fields) == encoded AND decode(encoded) == fields.

format.type: Message type: dis, dio, dao, dao_ack
format.encoded: Binary message as hex string (excluding ICMPv6 header)
format.expect_error: Error code for malformed input (if present, parsing must fail)

vectors.name: dis_base
vectors.description: Normal DODAG Information Solicitation: zero flags, zero reserved (RFC 6550 6.2)

vectors.name: dis_flags_ignored
vectors.description: RFC 6550 6.2: receivers MUST ignore DIS flag bits

vectors.name: dis_truncated
vectors.description: DIS shorter than two-byte base must be rejected

vectors.name: dis_nonzero_reserved
vectors.description: Nonzero DIS Reserved byte violates RFC 6550 6.2

vectors.name: dio_base
vectors.description: LICHEN root RPL DIO with AddrForKey DODAGID and SCHC Rule Version option

vectors.name: dio_non_root
vectors.description: LICHEN non-root parent DIO at rank 512

vectors.name: dio_malformed_version_length_zero
vectors.description: Type 0x13 option with Length zero is not canonical

vectors.name: dio_duplicate_version_option
vectors.description: Two Type 0x13 options must be rejected

vectors.name: dao_base
vectors.description: Base RPL DAO without DODAGID (D flag clear)

vectors.name: dao_ack_accept
vectors.description: Successful DAO acknowledgement: status 0, no DODAGID

vectors.name: dao_ack_too_short
vectors.description: DAO-ACK shorter than four-byte base must be rejected

vectors.name: dao_ack_missing_dodagid
vectors.description: D flag set without DODAGID bytes must be rejected
